Alibaba (9988.HK) and Ping An (2318.HK) stay small as un-confirmed optionality; Power Assets (0006.HK) is contagion-buffer utility. I deliberately avoid the flow-chasing laggard reversal (solar/EV/metals) — those are 'unconfirmed turn / band low', not confirmed. ~32% cash is the HK-fragility hedge.
